links.comparator_used: Original unchanged Chinese surgical consent forms from nine hospitals
links.outcome: Readability, layperson comprehension and content quality (including risk information)
links.effect: LLM-simplified version improved readability and comprehension versus the original but reduced content quality, particularly risk information; no numeric values given in the abstract
links.tradeoff: Reduced content quality, particularly risk information, in the LLM-simplified version
links.quote: The LLM version improved readability and comprehension but reduced content quality, particularly risk information.

links.comparator_used: LLM-simplified consent forms without clinician revision
links.outcome: Content accuracy, clarity and layperson comprehension
links.effect: Clinician-revised version restored accuracy, maintained clarity and achieved the highest comprehension scores; no numeric values given in the abstract
links.quote: Clinician revision restored accuracy while maintaining clarity and achieved the highest comprehension scores.

links.comparator_used: LLM-simplified consent forms released without clinician revision
links.outcome: Content accuracy, clarity and layperson comprehension
links.effect: Clinician-revised version restored accuracy, maintained clarity and achieved the highest comprehension scores; no numeric values given in the abstract
links.quote: Clinician revision restored accuracy while maintaining clarity and achieved the highest comprehension scores.
